'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Jonas Jakubowski LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonas Jakubowski]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

* '''Player:''' [[Jonas Jakubowski]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
